# IGNIX verified sources (X Layer)

Fetched on 2026-10-04 from the OKLink verified-source API for the IgnixManager implementation
`0x126f5088cf077944933f5741fb71a6cc40f2942a` (behind the proxy
`0x96b51c57e5346d0c0198899243cf851d1e23c309`, chain 196).

Endpoint: `https://www.oklink.com/api/v5/explorer/contract/verify-contract-info?chainShortName=XLAYER&contractAddress=<addr>`

These files carry `SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT` and belong to the IGNIX authors. They are vendored
unmodified as a reference for interfaces and for the bonding-curve arithmetic. Only the manager, its
libraries and the vault interfaces are included. Compiler settings are in `SETTINGS-IgnixManager.json`.
